items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think the Galidoro's were faster than Josh and Alcune.

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a little Calidoro with Frank Clarnet. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. What about the Pete and Al? Man, those two guys are really used to Boston Clarnet. Where are they now? They must be somewhere. Who's that? Peter and Al Galidoro. Yeah, Peter. Oh. Al Galidoro. Excellent. Both of them.

I think the Galidoro's were faster than Heikens. They could. I think the Galidoro's were faster than Josh and Alcune. And those musicians. Yeah. And that's saying something. And I have a, you know the last time I saw. You know where they're playing? In Toscanini. They played with Toscanini. Geez. Are they playing the symphony? They're still playing. Yeah. Oh yeah. They went over to it all together. I see. Oh yeah. After Whiteman they went over to NBC symphony office. And by the way Tony Perrani got an offer to…
He was with Hycon a long time.
